name: concourse-campus-kit
description: Expo client and Node BFF for public university campus information.

scripts.build:demo: pnpm --filter @concourse/shared build && pnpm --filter @concourse/institutions build && CONCOURSE_STATIC_DEMO=1 INSTITUTION_ID=example pnpm --filter @concourse/mobile exec expo export --platform web --output-dir ../../dist-pages --clear && node scripts/prepare-pages-output.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts apps/bff/vitest.config.ts apps/mobile/app.config.ts apps/mobile/vitest.config.ts && turbo run lint
scripts.test: turbo run test && node --test scripts/serve-expo-export-port.test.mjs scripts/serve-expo-export-routes.test.mjs scripts/serve-expo-export.test.mjs scripts/verify-release-metadata.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @concourse/shared build && pnpm --filter @concourse/institutions build && pnpm --filter @concourse/bff build && node scripts/e2e-bff.mjs
scripts.verify:demo: pnpm test:demo:unit && pnpm build:demo && pnpm verify:demo:artifact && pnpm test:demo:web
